subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Months on end
solution:
The correct answer is **‘Several months in a row’.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**__Let's look at the meaning of the given Idioms__**

__
 
• **Months on end-** denotes **Several months in a row.**

 
 
• **For e.g.- **We've been waiting to close on the house for** months on end**—when will this process finally be over?
 
 
 
• Thus, according to the above mentioned meaning of the asked word it is clear that 1st option is correct and therefore the answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meaning of all the phrases given:.
 
 
• **Last month of the year** means December or the twelfth month of the year.

 
 
• Example- The family was in a joyous mood with picnics and parties in the last month of the year.
 
 
 
• **End of the month** means last days of a month.
 
 
• Example- It is too difficult for Vijay to meet his ends at the end of the month.
 
 
 
• **In a month’s time** means 30 days or 1 month.
 
 
• Example- Rima will achieve her goal in a month’s time.
